# Tickets (revision 1, proposed 2026-11-04)

Order: T1 first; T2 and T3 after T1 (they share no file); T4 after T1. Test output: `.artifacts/2026-11-04-1920x1080-format/` (only the T4 captures; deleted after owner acceptance unless kept as evidence).

- [x] T1 — The 1920x1080 format exists, offered to category-a, linked to template-1; supports R1, R2, R4, A6, A7; depends on: none; verify: `composer test` (from `server/`), `composer lint`.; verified: FINDINGS V1, V1-review
  - Scope may change: `server/app/FormatCatalog.php` (definition `fmt-hd` 1920x1080 sort 11, `CATEGORIES['fmt-hd'] = ['category-a']`, new `TEMPLATES` map `'fmt-hd' => ['template-1']`); new migration creating `format_template` (preset FK, template FK, both cascade on delete, unique pair, index on template); new migration adding `fmt-hd` and its category-a and template-1 links on a live database (additive, idempotent, links frozen in the migration, skips a missing category or template, `down` removes only an unused preset row); `server/app/Models/Format.php` (`templates()` relation); `server/database/seeders/FormatSeeder.php` (links templates that exist; skips a template-limited preset when none of its templates exists, same reason as D1) and `DatabaseSeeder.php` (runs FormatSeeder after LayoutSeeder, so template rows exist on a fresh database); `FormatController::payload` and `index` (adds `template_ids`, eager-loaded; empty list = every template); `server/lang/locale.json` key `format.fmt-hd` = "1920 × 1080 px"; `CONTEXT.md` "Format" entry (links to Templates); generated `web/app/src/i18n/locale.json` via `npm run sync:i18n` only.
  - Must not change: other presets' rows, sort orders or category links; layout packs; `LayoutCatalog`.
  - Acceptance: `GET /formats` for category-a lists `fmt-hd` last with `template_ids` = [template-1's id]; every other preset has `template_ids` = []; category-b does not get `fmt-hd`. Running the migration twice adds nothing twice. On a database that has no template-1 row the migration adds nothing, so the format can never appear unlinked and open to every template (DECISIONS D1, by: agent).
  - Test seam: feature tests on `GET /api/formats` (FormatTest, CategoryOfferTest) and a migration test running `up()` twice on a seeded database. Catches payload, order, category filter, idempotency. Misses MySQL-only behaviour; the migration uses only portable query-builder calls.
  - TDD: yes.
  - Rules: AGENTS.md (live data by additive idempotent migration, never a seeder), `.claude/rules/backend.md` (FK/index/unique in migration, explicit payload, eager loading).
